purpose_context: A demanding real adopter (the spec-kitty proving ground) cannot move to doc-kitty without renaming ~60 index.md files to README.md, reworking section folders its governance names differently, and risking ~1,589 dead URLs when .html paths become clean URLs. This mission removes those three friction points as first-class supported toolkit capabilities — accept index.md as a section index, let a section-folder rename carry its derived type and routes, and ship a redirect-coverage gate that fails CI before an adopter serves a live 404. Each also fixes a doc-kitty inconsistency (the dogfooding dividend).
purpose_tldr: Let adopters bring an existing docs tree to doc-kitty without renaming index files, fighting folder renames, or breaking URLs.
